capabilities.title: DTG printing
capabilities.desc: Direct-to-garment printing for photographs, gradients and detailed artwork on cotton and cotton-rich apparel.

capabilities.title: Computerised embroidery
capabilities.desc: Digitised designs and multi-head embroidery bring texture and a distinctive finish to your brand identity.

capabilities.title: Sublimation printing
capabilities.desc: All-over printing bonds colour into polyester fibres for expressive, full-coverage apparel and sportswear.

capabilities.title: Laser cutting & engraving
capabilities.desc: Precision cutting and engraving for personalised gifts and decor in wood, acrylic, leather and fabric.
